Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Team

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

What You'll Do

Product Management

  • Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

  • Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.

  • Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.

  • Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.

  • Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.

  • Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.

  • Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

Execution and Individual Contribution

  • Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.

  • Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.

  • Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.

  • Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

Who You Are

  • Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly.

  • Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering.

  • A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

  • Transparent about areas of growth and open to learning, rather than presenting incomplete information as fully resolved under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience weighing compute cost against performance and developer experience, and driving that tradeoff to a decision rather than just planning around it.

  • Working knowledge of how AI agents consume data and tools differently from people, and judgment on when a vendor's own agent layer already covers a need.

  • A proactive approach to navigating and understanding new technical systems, key contacts, and open questions independently.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The salary band for this position ranges from €90,000 - 120,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

  • Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance.

  • Temporary work from abroad policy.

  • Regular team and social events.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Engine (m/w/d)
description: Unser Mandant entwickelt innovative Decision-Intelligence-Software für datengestützte Entscheidungen und komplexe betriebliche Abläufe. Das Ziel ist es, Organisationen dabei zu helfen, Abhängigkeiten transparent zu machen, Handlungsoptionen zu evaluieren und Entscheidungen zu treffen, deren Logik und Annahmen jederzeit nachvollziehbar sind. Dafür wird eine leistungsfähige Kerntechnologie aufgebaut, die strukturiertes Wissen, logisches Schlussfolgern (Reasoning), Planung und KI-Komponenten vereint. Als Senior Product Manager bist du das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen Marktbedürfnissen, Customer Insights und technischer Umsetzungsstärke. Deine Mission: ein sich schnell entwickelndes, marktorientiertes Produkt abzuliefern, das geschäftlichen Mehrwert, Produktvision und technische Machbarkeit perfekt ausbalanciert. Du steuerst den Produktlebenszyklus von der ersten Idee bis zum Product-Market-Fit und arbeitest dabei funktionsübergreifend mit Softwareentwicklung, Data Science, Vertrieb und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der genau das bereits erfolgreich getan hat: Produkte in einem Startup-Umfeld aufzubauen und zu skalieren. Deine Challenges: Produktstrategie & Roadmap: Führung der Produktstrategie in Abstimmung mit den Geschäftszielen sowie Übersetzung der Vision in umsetzbare Pläne. Product-Market-Fit: Steuerung des Produkts von Problem-Fit über Solution-Fit bis hin zum Product-Market-Fit unter Nutzung schlanker, hypothesengeleiteter und iterativer Methoden. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die vertriebliche Performance und Weiterentwicklung unseres gesamten Key Account Teams . Du führst als Player-Coach, entwickelst unsere KAMs individuell weiter und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Vertriebsmitarbeitern zunehmend selbstständige und strategisch agierende Umsatzträger werden. Dabei geht es nicht darum, die schwierigsten Deals selbst zu übernehmen. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, dass dein Team diese Deals zunehmend selbst erfolgreich abschließt. Du definierst gemeinsam mit deinen Teammitgliedern konkrete Entwicklungsziele und Maßnahmen. Du coachst direkt an realen Accounts, Opportunities und Kundensituationen. Du entwickelst deine KAMs insbesondere in den Bereichen Neukundenakquisition, strategisches Account Management, Value Selling, Entscheider-Management, Verhandlung und Closing . Du bereitest wichtige Kundentermine und Verhandlungen gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs vor und reflektierst diese anschließend. Du gibst Verantwortung nicht an dich, sondern an dein Team zurück und entwickelst dadurch Selbstständigkeit und Ownership. Vertriebssteuerung & Performance Du übersetzt unsere Unternehmens- und Sales-Ziele in klare Ziele und Erwartungen für das Team. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den KAMs Umsatz, Pipeline, Account-Entwicklung und Neukundenakquisition . Du stellst eine belastbare Pipeline und einen realistischen Forecast sicher. Du erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, Pipeline-Lücken und Performance-Abweichungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Maßnahmen ein. Du führst regelmäßige Account- und Opportunity Reviews durch und stellst sicher, dass die richtigen Strategien und nächsten Schritte verfolgt werden. Sales Excellence Du etablierst klare und einheitliche Vertriebsstandards. Du entwickelst Best Practices und sorgst dafür, dass diese im gesamten Team angewendet werden. Du stärkst eine konsequente Akquisitions-, Wachstums- und Abschlussorientierung . Du entwickelst das Team von reaktiver Kundenbetreuung hin zu aktiver und strategischer Geschäftsentwicklung. Du stärkst die Ownership für Pipeline, Umsatz und nachhaltiges Subskriptionswachstum. Player-Coach – ca. 20 % eigene Sales-Aktivität Du bleibst selbst nah am Markt und an unseren Kunden. Rund 20 % deiner Zeit investierst du in eigene operative Vertriebsaktivitäten. Dabei übernimmst du bewusst eine begrenzte Anzahl eigener Accounts und Opportunities, betreibst selbst Neukundenakquisition und arbeitest bei ausgewählten strategischen oder komplexen Opportunities gemeinsam mit deinen KAMs. Deine eigene Vertriebsarbeit hat vor allem einen Zweck: Du machst Best Practices vor, bleibst nah am Markt und bringst deine Erfahrung direkt in das Coaching deines Teams ein. Qualifikation Du bist ein erfahrener Sales-Profi und hast selbst erfolgreich komplexe Vertriebsprozesse gesteuert. Gleichzeitig verstehst du, dass nachhaltiger Vertriebserfolg entsteht, wenn Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. raw.title: Founding AI Engineer @handly - 20VC backed
raw.description:
Germany has about a million trade businesses. They do more than €700 billion of work a year, and they run almost all of it by hand: quotes in the evening, invoices on the weekend, payments chased between jobs.

For decades, the software built for them was made for desk workers. Forms, menus, dropdowns, buttons. None of it was made for people who are always on the go and only care about the outcome.

AI changes that. For the first time, the admin of a trade business can be done for the owner instead of by them.

We are building a business-in-a-box for the trades.

Tradespeople want outcomes done for them, with as little interaction with software as possible. handly takes care of leads, quotes, measurements, invoicing and payments, so they can focus on their craft, and is accountable for the result.

We started with roofers in Germany. Other trades are next.

Delivering outcomes is a much harder problem than delivering software. That is the job of an AI-native services company. Most of our vision has not been built yet, and we are looking for top-tier talent in Berlin to help us bring it to life.

We are a small, close-knit team in Berlin-Mitte, backed by 20VC, Stride and Base10. We build, experiment and move fast, and we have found creative ways to use AI in every part of the company: product, ops, go-to-market and admin.

about the role

This role is for engineers who want to push what AI can do for a real business. As our founding AI engineer, you'll have high agency to hone your skills with AI and solve hard real-world problems that bring delightful experiences to our partners.

The biggest opportunity at handly: we run the entire administration of our partners, rather than one vertical of their needs. That gives AI the room to take on large, autonomous tasks end to end, and gives us room to get very creative with what AI can do as we capture more and more channels of communication.

You will own AI products end to end, make the core product and technical decisions, and turn messy, real-world workflows into AI that does the work for our partners.

We are a small team working on:

  • modernizing the user experience of an underserved industry
  • reimagining workflows that have not changed in decades, with AI
  • moving from AI workflows to high-autonomy agents
  • capturing data and context from calls, emails, photos, documents and voice

Tasks

AI already runs in production across handly: intelligence on every customer call, automatic payment matching, a daily briefing for every partner. Some of the bigger projects you will contribute to or lead:

  • Quote generation. Turn voice notes, photos and documents from customers and architects into a six-figure quote, priced intelligently from the partner's own catalog.
  • Measurements. Measure buildings from satellite imagery, drone footage and public building data, without a site visit.
  • Back office in natural language. An MCP layer over the whole product, so partners can manage their back office in a chat.
  • Email intelligence. Capture intelligence from email threads and attachments, automate communication with clients and suppliers, and aggressive anti-phishing and spam protection.
  • Self-improving pipelines. Use every correction, edit and rejection to improve the next output.
  • Evals. Build the evaluation sets and benchmarks that gate every AI feature before it ships.

Requirements

  • Have 4+ years of full-stack engineering experience (exceptions apply for exceptional engineers)
  • You have shipped AI features that real users depend on, and continiously evloved them.
  • Strong full-stack TypeScript comfortable across backend, web and mobile.
  • Experience building evals, benchmarks and self-improving loops that automate research on AI capabilities.
  • Creative about capturing data and context (transcripts, photos, documents, voice) to improve AI features.
  • Strong prompt engineering: structured outputs, tool use, agents, and good judgment about when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You lead your projects end to end and want to grow with the company.
  • Bonus: you have built your own fully functional AI side project. Send us your best one.

our tech stack

  • Full-stack TypeScript: Node.js, Express, Drizzle, Postgres
  • Web: React, Vite, React Query, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Zod
  • Mobile: React Native, Expo, EAS, React Query
  • AI: Vercel AI SDK, promptfoo, OpenAI and Anthropic models
  • Building: we use AI extensively to build, with zero friction adopting the best tools, and we built a custom software factory that takes care of small tasks
  • Infra: AWS, PostHog, Sentry

what may not make you a good fit

  • you prefer a remote or hybrid setup
  • you want to be told exactly what to do
  • you mostly care about the tech, not the outcome for the customer
  • you want to work 9-5

Benefits

  • competitive compensation package, €80–110k + 0.4–0.7% equity
  • unlimited access to frontier models and our always-on software factory
  • as much responsibility as you want, flat hierarchy
  • fast loops and direct feedback from the people who use what you build
  • minimal meetings: we have plannings and demo Fridays, No stand-ups, we like to maximize our focus time.
  • a tight, ambitious team that enjoys building hard things together from the comfort of our office.
  • regular team outings: dinners, padel, events and movie nights
  • a modern, light-filled office in Berlin-Mitte and great vibes ^^

Process

  1. Intro with Ohan (30m)
  2. Technical Background with Kais (45m)
  3. AI Product Engineering Challenge (3-4h)
  4. On-site with the product team and our CEO Basti - white-boarding, product taste & culture (half-day)

That’s it! We’ll reach out with an offer.

Start date: ASAP

Location: Berlin only, in-office

description: Deine Rolle Du unterstützt uns dabei, die On-Premise-Cloud-Plattform von OVHcloud weiterzuentwickeln, zu betreiben und zu industrialisieren. Als Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams arbeitest du an unserer OpenStack-basierten Infrastruktur sowie am Kubernetes- und GitOps-Stack, auf dem unsere kundenorientierte Cloud-Plattform läuft. AI-Assisted Engineering ist dabei ein fester Bestandteil unserer täglichen Engineering-Praxis – von Spec-Driven Development über agentische Coding-Workflows bis hin zu Incident Response und Automatisierung. Die Plattform befindet sich aktiv im Aufbau, sodass du direkten Einfluss auf Architektur, Automatisierungsstrategie und den Einsatz von AI im Platform Engineering hast. Als Senior übernimmst du Ownership für deine Themen und gestaltest deinen fachlichen Schwerpunkt entlang deiner Stärken – mit Fokus auf Automation, Compute Lifecycle, Platform Engineering und AI Substrate. Unser Tech Stack 🚀 · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst und entwickelst unsere OpenStack-basierte On-Premise-Cloud-Infrastruktur mit dem Ziel, komplette Cloud-Umgebungen hochautomatisiert auf Bare Metal ausrollen und in Betrieb nehmen zu können. Du entwickelst und betreibst Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible und Terraform sowie unsere Kubernetes- und GitOps-Workflows mit FluxCD / ArgoCD - unterstützt durch LLMs, agentische Workflows und automatisierte Test- und Review-Prozesse. Du verantwortest den Lifecycle unserer Compute-Infrastruktur - von Bare Metal, Firmware und Provisionierung bis zu Hypervisoren und virtuellen Compute Nodes. Dazu gehören unter anderem Patching, Migrationen, Host Evacuations, Capacity Rebalancing und die Automatisierung eines stabilen Plattformbetriebs. Du entwickelst unser AI Substrate und unsere Self-Healing-Strategie weiter - von strukturierten Knowledge Bases und agentischen Workflows für Incident Triage und Capacity Planning bis hin zur schrittweisen Automatisierung heutiger Runbooks. Du konzipierst Tests für Non-Regression, Performance und Security, dokumentierst und paketierst Lösungen und verbesserst die Plattform kontinuierlich anhand von Telemetrie, Betriebserfahrungen und Nutzerfeedback. Als Senior Engineer bist du technische Ansprechperson und Sparringspartner für Kolleg rund um Automation, Platform Engineering und AI Tooling. title: Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d)
description: The role We’re looking for a Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d) to join our team and play a key role in developing software that connects and translates lab equipment hardware interfaces, automates machines, and powers our next-generation automation platform. As a core team member, you will be working on cutting-edge technology, building software that bridges the gap between software and hardware, enabling seamless integration across various vendors. Connectors are how we do it. Every instrument we bring online gets one, and every connector is built on our shared Python libraries: Bus, our Connector Development Kit, and the stack underneath them. Our mission is to empower researchers and engineers by bridging the gap between lab equipment and cloud-based automation. Our customers are solving critical challenges like curing diseases, developing sustainable materials, and addressing global food security. We provide them with the tools to connect their devices, automate workflows, and unlock new possibilities in R&D. Your mandate has two halves. Own the libraries as a product with real users, our own engineers today and external contributors later. And stay close enough to customer connector work that what you build is grounded in problems that actually exist. Why you'll love this role Your users are engineers. Your success lets other people ship connectors faster. That's a different craft from shipping features, and it's the one we're hiring for. Real hardware, real failure modes. Instruments time out, return garbage, and arrive with documentation that's wrong. You'll debug against physical devices in our Munich workshop. Open source on purpose. Our CDK and our standardization work ( SiLA 2) are public. What you build gets used and criticized by people outside the company. Senior scope, small team. You'll be the person who decides how connector engineering works here. No layer between you and that decision. Your mission 1. The Builder: own the shared libraries Own Bus, the CDK, and the core stack. Features, tests, CI, releases, and deprecations across the connectors already running in production. Extract abstractions from real work. When the same pattern shows up in the third connector, it becomes a library feature. You're the one who notices, and the one who does it. Make the docs good enough to remove yourself. An outside contributor should be able to build a connector on our libraries without a call. Set the quality standard. You define what "tested" means before a connector reaches a customer, and you make it stick. 2. The Shipper: build connectors on real instruments Ship production connectors end to end. Spec sheet, physical device, protocol, proof of connectivity, tested connector, live customer. Independently. Reverse-engineer what isn't documented. Roughly half the instruments we touch have incomplete or wrong docs. Packet captures, trial and error, vendor calls. Work with the workshop. Our Connector Factory team gets instruments development-ready. You take it from there. Talk to the people who use it. Automation engineers and scientists at biotech and pharma customers. Their constraints shape what the libraries need next. Your profile Deep Python: 5+ years of writing production Python other people depend on. Async, typing, packaging, testing. You've designed APIs that other engineers built on, not just glue code. You've debugged a real protocol against real hardware: gRPC, serial, TCP, OPC UA, CAN, USB. Which one matters less than having sat with a packet capture and a device that won't respond. You ship without a spec: When the documentation is wrong, you reverse-engineer, instead of filing a vendor ticket and waiting. You build for other developers: An SDK, a library, an internal platform. Something where your job was making other engineers faster. Located in Munich: The instruments are physically here at WERK1. Nice to have SiLA 2, or another device abstraction and interoperability standard Lab automation, scientific instruments, or a life science background Open source maintainership with actual external contributors C, C++, .NET, or Rust, for the vendor DLLs and drivers we end up wrapping Docker, Kubernetes, edge deployment German, for vendor conversations Probably not a fit if Better to say this now than in week 6. Your Python is all APIs and databases and you've never debugged a physical device. You'd want two quarters to redesign the library architecture before shipping a connector. You like shipping integrations but have no appetite for going back afterwards to generalise, test, and document. You want the library work without the customer deadlines. Both are in the job. About UniteLabs UniteLabs is on the mission to accelerate scientific progress by automating lab processes with scalable infrastructure. We’re a startup based in Munich, Germany, pioneering an industry-first integration platform for lab automation, bridging hardware and software across vendor barriers to revolutionize life science R&D. By digitalizing life science R&D, we enable researchers in biotech, pharma, chemistry, and food industries to accelerate their work in groundbreaking fields such as disease treatment, sustainable materials, and food security. Our platform empowers customers to analyze more data, run autonomous experiments, and leverage AI-driven solutions, driving innovation and efficiency. At UniteLabs, we are committed to providing the infrastructure that powers the future of scientific discovery. As one of the first full-time hires, you'll thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and take on significant responsibilities from day one. We are a tech-driven company that takes pride in our solutions—and we’re looking for individuals who share that passion and want to grow with the company into leadership and expert roles. Why You’ll Love Working Here Impactful Work : Work on meaningful products in an ambitious, supportive environment as part of a team revolutionizing connectivity in laboratory automation to enable breakthroughs in science and technology. Work with the Best: Join a talented, ambitious team in a dynamic, transparent environment where your ideas help shape the company's future. Collaborative Culture: Team-oriented environment focused on continuous knowledge-sharing and professional growth, with regular team-building activities including offsites and work-cations. Flexible Environment: Backed by an employee-first culture that supports flexible remote work and PTO, with our main office in the vibrant WERK1 Munich hub. Hardware debugging happens there, so being regularly onsite is a must. Attractive Compensation Package: Competitive compensation with growth potential in a VC-backed startup, along with a laptop of choice, annual productivity budget, and a growing list of benefits for sports, mobility, insurance, and more. Tech stack A non-exhaustive list of our main technologies and tools used for a given task: Connectors: Python, SiLA 2, gRPC, zeroconf Workflows: Python, Prefect Services: TypeScript, NestJS, Prisma Web: TypeScript, Vue 3, Nuxt 3, TailwindCSS Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, Terraform Databases: PostgreSQL How to apply If you’re passionate about automation, have a customer-focused mindset, and are ready to define the future of smart labs, we’d love to hear from you. Share your CV or LinkedIn profile, along with your responses to the three questions in the application form. Let’s build the future of lab automation together. Apply today! Leadership Impact</strong> <strong>(Build Championship Teams)</strong></p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Liaise with fulfillment operations, logistics, merchandising, marketing, business analytics, Partnerships, and technology teams to gather information, provide key insights, and resolve issues across the organization.</li> <li>Coordinate resources, remove barriers, and work cross-functionally with external partners including marketplace operations, drop ship vendors, and MTO/3PL partners to ensure seamless operations.</li> <li>Lead and present Fan Services operational data on daily, weekly, and monthly business review calls to senior and executive leadership, proactively communicating core KPIs and delivering strategies to overcome operational challenges.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>People Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage staffing, workflows, and performance seamlessly for on-premises, hybrid, and remote employees, maximizing team performance through training, motivation, project management, and incentive programs.</li> <li>Develop succession plans and talent pipelines for managers, supervisors, and team leaders to build organizational depth and resilience.</li> <li>Deploy policies, procedures, and service level standards across the customer service organization in partnership with global teams to ensure consistent, high-quality execution.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fan &amp; Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Own the voice of the fan by serving as the subject matter expert for customer sentiment and feedback, strategizing messaging that adapts to fan needs and enhances the Fanatics brand globally.</li> <li>Consistently analyze and leverage data to drive targets and process improvements across key metrics including Net Promoter Score, Customer Satisfaction/Customer Delight, First Contact Resolution, Appeasement per Contact, and Contacts per Order.</li> <li>Identify and reduce contact drivers through innovative solutions while ensuring adherence to all appropriate regulatory and compliance frameworks, including PCI/PII and GDPR.</li> <li>Develop and manage BPO and vendor partner relationships — including performance, cost, and contract oversight — to ensure fans receive best-in-class service across every channel.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Innovation &amp; Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Apply strong technical proficiency across customer experience technologies including contact experience platforms, e-commerce front-end/back-end tools, order management systems, content management systems, and AI/Machine Learning-powered conversation analytics systems to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Leverage omni-channel operational expertise to identify gaps, design scalable solutions, and enhance the end-to-end fan service experience across all touchpoints.</li> <li>Bring innovative approaches to first and second line contact management, improving resolution rates and reducing friction across own and 3PL operations.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to integrate emerging technologies and data-driven tools to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and elevate fan outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ownership &amp; Execution</strong> (Determined &amp; Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Own the strategic roadmap, budget, and resource planning for the Fan Services customer service organization, aligning headcount, technology, and vendor/BPO investment to business goals.</li> <li>Drive performance management across the team with a disciplined focus on financial targets and third-party SLAs, ensuring accountability at every level of the organization.</li> <li>Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating the ability to manage competing priorities with urgency and composure while delivering results at scale.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently in writing, speaking, and digital formats to senior-level and C-level audiences, translating operational complexity into strategic insight.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>AI &amp; DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES &amp; EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of customer operations experience, including deep expertise in first and second line contact management and managing own and 3PL operations.</li> <li>7+ years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading leaders and managers across on-premises, hybrid, and remote environments.</li> <li>Experience and understanding of omni-channel operations and the e-commerce space.</li> <li>Advanced communication skills in writing, speaking, and digital formats, with the ability to deliver comfortably to senior-level and C-level audiences.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including foundational experience with Excel and pivot tables; knowledgeable user of CRM technologies, Conversation-Analytics Software, Contact Center Technologies, Customer Review Tools, and order management tools such as EDI, DAX, and Cloud Reporting.</li> <li>Proven track record of owning departmental budgets, headcount planning, and BPO/vendor relationships including performance, cost, and contract oversight.</li> <li>Multi-lingual candidates are encouraged to apply; Spanish, French, and German are preferred.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Education:</strong></p> <p>Bachelor's degree in business, communications, management, or a related field.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Stakehill.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.</em></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT THE TEAM</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, <a href="http://www.fanatics.com">www.fanatics.com</a>.</em><br><br><em>Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).</em><br><br><em>At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:</em><br><em>· Build Championship Teams</em><br><em>· Obsessed with Fans</em><br><em>· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit</em><br><em>· Determined and Relentless Mindset</em></p> <p><em>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our&nbsp;<a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator (RevTech)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.</p> <p>Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to <strong>be curious, have courage, and commit fully</strong>.</p> <p>Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator (RevTech) to join our Information Systems team, responsible for the technical ownership, administration, and optimisation of our Salesforce based Revenue Technology stack.</p> <p>This role will play a critical part in ensuring our commercial systems (Sales Cloud, Gong, QuotaPath, ABM platforms, and other related tools) are reliable, well-integrated, and enabling scalable revenue operations.</p> <p>You will work within our Salesforce team, liaising closely with the data team, and business stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to ensure systems and integrations support end-to-end revenue processes and help optimise the tech stack to deliver tech efficiencies to the company.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>RevTech System Ownership</li> <ul> <li>Act as the technical SME for the RevTech ecosystem, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs.</li> <li>Own the administration, configuration, and ongoing optimisation of RevTech tools (Salesforce Sales Cloud, Gong, QuotaPath, ABM platforms, enablement tools).</li> </ul> <li>Integration &amp; Data</li> <ul> <li>Monitor and support integrations between Salesforce, RevTech tools and other key business systems.</li> <li>Investigate data-flow issues and work with internal engineering teams or external partners to resolve them.</li> <li>Gather requirements and contribute Salesforce expertise to integration design.</li> <li>Support the move towards an enterprise integration model using MuleSoft.</li> </ul> <li>Process Enablement</li> <ul> <li>Support key revenue processes such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, and customer lifecycle management.Partner with RevOps, Sales, Finance and CS teams to translate business requirements into system solutions.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.</li> </ul> <li>Data &amp; Reporting</li> <ul> <li>Ensure accurate and timely data flows between systems to support reporting and analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Data team to ensure RevTech data is properly modelled and available in downstream systems (e.g. Databricks, BI tools).</li> </ul> <li>Governance &amp; Best Practice</li> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain standards for system configuration, documentation, and change management.</li> <li>Ensure appropriate access controls, compliance, and auditability across the RevTech stack.</li> <li>Contribute to overall enterprise architecture and systems strategy.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Criteria&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong hands-on Salesforce administration experience using Sales Cloud.</li> <li>Experience configuring Salesforce Flow, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reports and dashboards.</li> <li>Experience supporting RevOps systems such as Gong, QuotaPath, Outreach, Salesloft or similar platforms.</li> <li>A good understanding of SaaS integrations and how data moves between Salesforce and connected systems.</li> <li>Experience supporting revenue processes such as lead-to-opportunity, customer lifecycle management or quote-to-cash.</li> <li>Ability to translate requirements from Sales, Customer Success and Finance into practical system improvements.</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Criteria</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Einstein Conversation Insights, Gong or similar conversation intelligence tools&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working in an M&amp;A, PE backed, high-growth SaaS environment.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Mulesoft.</li> <li>Familiarity with data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake) and data pipelines.</li> <li>Exposure to quote-to-cash processes and RevOps tooling.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Join our team and enjoy a competitive salary with bonus opportunities, flexible work schedules, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. We offer flexible time off plans, career growth through development programs, and a collaborative, innovative culture where your ideas matter.&nbsp; Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be part of a company that invests in your success!</p> <p>We are committed to providing a Drug-Free Workplace for all employees.</p> <p>We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.</p> <p>You can view our Recruitment and Selection Policy <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yDxHyVbhh8MK9NnCYdnEAfVSO4rhPCovVbKK8ecxT4U/edit?usp=sharing">here.</a></p> <p>Please click the link for our <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1uAKvHVSRsqZ83CGhM3_3Dc6RPsXwlTdmwdUH7msHkVM/edit?usp=sharing">Privacy Notice</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Payments Optimisation Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role is responsible for making sure customers can pay successfully and that the business is not losing revenue through avoidable payment failures. This role will identify issues, bring the right teams together and ensure that changes are implemented and measured.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Role purpose</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Will be responsible for ensuring that all payment methods, payment providers and checkout journeys operate to an optimal standard across the business.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will monitor payment acceptance, identify performance issues and opportunities, and work with payment service providers, acquiring banks, technology teams, product teams and commercial stakeholders to improve successful payment completion and reduce avoidable customer friction.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The successful candidate will take ownership of payment-performance reporting, incident escalation and optimisation activity, ensuring that issues are identified quickly, investigated thoroughly and converted into measurable improvements in revenue and customer experience.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Payment performance monitoring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor payment performance across cards, digital wallets, PayPal, BNPL and other alternative payment methods.&nbsp;</li> <li>Track authorisation, acceptance and completion rates by brand, market, payment method, provider, issuer, device and customer journey.&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify deterioration, unusual trends and performance gaps requiring investigation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop appropriate alerts and thresholds so material payment issues are identified quickly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain regular reporting that clearly explains performance, causes of movement and actions being taken.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance investigation and optimisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Investigate payment failures and determine whether the cause sits with the PSP, acquirer, issuer, internal technology, checkout journey, fraud controls or customer behaviour.&nbsp;</li> <li>Analyse decline codes, authentication outcomes, technical failures, retries and abandonment points.&nbsp;</li> <li>Recommend changes to improve acceptance while maintaining appropriate fraud and risk controls.&nbsp;</li> <li>Measure the impact of changes and demonstrate the resulting revenue, acceptance or customer-experience benefit.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a prioritised payment-optimisation roadmap.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PSP and partner management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the operational performance contact for PSPs, acquirers and payment-method partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Challenge providers where performance falls below expectations and ensure issues are investigated and resolved.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hold regular performance reviews with partners and track agreed actions through to completion.&nbsp;</li> <li>Compare provider performance across markets, payment methods and transaction types.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support commercial discussions by providing performance evidence and identifying service or contractual shortcomings.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Internal stakeholder management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Technology, Product, Finance, Fraud, Treasury, Customer Experience and Commercial teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Translate complex payment issues into clear business language and explain the revenue and customer impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate internal investigations and ensure actions have clear owners and deadlines.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support new payment-method launches, PSP migrations and checkout changes from a performance perspective.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure payment-performance requirements are considered during product and technical design.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting and governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Produce weekly and monthly payment-performance reporting for senior stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide clear commentary on what changed, why it changed and what action is required.&nbsp;</li> <li>Track incidents, root causes, corrective actions and realised benefits.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain appropriate documentation for payment journeys, providers, escalation routes and performance expectations.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key measures of success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overall payment acceptance and completion rate.&nbsp;</li> <li>Card authorisation rate.&nbsp;</li> <li>Payment-method performance by provider, brand and market.&nbsp;</li> <li>Reduction in avoidable technical and processing failures.&nbsp;</li> <li>Revenue recovered or protected through optimisation activity.&nbsp;</li> <li>Speed of identification and resolution of payment incidents.&nbsp;</li> <li>Delivery of PSP and internal corrective actions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Performance of retries and recovery journeys.&nbsp;</li> <li>Customer payment abandonment and failure rates.&nbsp;</li> <li>Accuracy and usefulness of payment-performance reporting.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in payments, ecommerce, financial services or a related environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of online payment journeys and payment service providers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience analysing payment acceptance, authorisation or transaction-performance data.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes and commercial opportunities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with PSPs, acquirers or other external payment partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to coordinate technical and non-technical stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex issues clearly.&nbsp;</li> <li>Commercial awareness and an understanding of how payment performance affects revenue and customer experience.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple investigations and actions.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of card schemes, issuers, acquirers and payment-processing flows.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of 3DS, SCA, exemptions, tokenisation, network tokens and account updater services.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with digital wallets, PayPal, BNPL and alternative payment methods.&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of payment decline codes and issuer behaviour.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience using SQL, BI tools or payment analytics platforms.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understanding of fraud controls and the relationship between acceptance and fraud risk.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience supporting PSP migrations, payment orchestration or new payment-method launches.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in a high-volume international ecommerce environment.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Personal attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Data-led and commercially focused.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proactive and comfortable challenging internal teams and external providers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Naturally curious and willing to investigate issues in detail.&nbsp;</li> <li>Able to remain calm and structured during payment incidents.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong ownership mentality with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable operating across technical, operational and commercial teams.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: Drata is building the trust layer between great companies - automating compliance, managing risk, and helping organizations prove trust continuously as they scale. Why Join the Drata Team? At Drata, you're not maintaining legacy compliance software - you're building the agentic AI platform defining what trust looks like for the next generation of companies. Growth at rocketship speed: Drata is scaling fast, which means scope grows fast too. High performers get more ownership, visibility, and experience. You are thoughtful about the ways you communicate and the impact that may have on a customer. You have the ability to sense when a conversation is progressing in a positive or negative way and have the confidence to address concerns. Confident but always striving to do better. You are not afraid to ask for help. You value honest, action-oriented feedback and believe it is a tool to improve as a team. How we support you: At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving. Explore how we invest in your Life at Drata . Shared Success : We provide stock equity to ensure that as the company grows, you share directly in that success. Equity gives every employee a sense of ownership and the opportunity to celebrate our wins together—because your contributions don’t just support our progress; they help drive our collective success. Health & Wellness: Up to 100% employer-paid premiums for medical, employees and their dependents Financial Well-being: To support your retirement planning, our EOR offers a pension plan under which you contribute 5% of your basic earnings, and your employer contributes an additional 4%, helping you build a more secure financial future. Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Growth & Development: Generous annual stipends for both professional and personal development, empowering you to invest in your continued growth. You’ll also have access to a wide range of internal learning opportunities, ensuring you can build new skills, deepen your expertise, and advance your career with confidence. Time Off & Flexibility: We believe that to do your best work, you should get the time you need for rest, rejuvenation and recovery. Drata offers a flexible vacation policy, paid holidays, and other perks to recharge. The expected OTE range for this role is between £193,500 - £225,800 (UK), €232,050 - €273,000 (EMEA), and is listed to provide transparency. Actual base pay will vary based on multiple factors — market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment to the role. Candidates shouldn't expect automatic placement at any particular point within the range. Offer amounts are determined by the qualifications each candidate brings to the position. Total compensation may also include equity designed to provide meaningful ownership in the company, as well as health and wellbeing benefits. title: Senior CRM Manager
description: We’re on a mission to make migration easy. We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work. This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) Please note we are not in a position to offer sponsorship and/or a visa for this position. What you'll be doing Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation. Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teams Enable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency. Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications. Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impact Drive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management. Who you are You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work. You’re curious and collaborative , and you like working with lots of different stakeholders to move work forward. You’re someone who believes in enabling others , not gatekeeping expertise, and you’re motivated by helping teams do better work together You’re commercially minded and pragmatic , with a strong instinct for where to focus your time to unlock the most value What you'll bring Experience working in CRM operations or CRM management within an in-house, tech-led business , with a strong understanding of growth-focused customer communications. Recent hands-on experience with Braze is preferable for the role, alongside practical experience building and managing CRM campaigns, segmentation, metadata, scheduling, and audience setup Proven experience creating CRM governance and enabling other teams to use CRM effectively across an organisation Strong data literacy , including analysing campaign or email test performance, pulling audiences and segments, and working independently with data rather than relying entirely on analyst support. Confidence in using data tools or AI-assisted analysis to generate insights and support decision-making. Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year Our Process We break it up into a few stages: Initial call with our Talent Acquisition Manager (approx. 40 mins via Zoom) A past experience interview with our Hiring Manager (60 minutes via Zoom) An Onsite task, where we would like to see how you think on your feet (120 minutes in-person) Culture interview with one of our senior Marshmallow leads (60 minutes via Zoom) Background checks As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment, we’ll carry out standard background checks, including a DBS and a Cifas check . These help ensure there are no ongoing criminal proceedings and support the prevention of fraud and other forms of serious misconduct. If anything of concern is identified, it may affect your eligibility for certain roles or services. Feel free to ask our Talent Acquisition team if you have any questions about this! #LI-OB1 Diversity of thought We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Partner, Strategic Account Management
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About the Role The AI Startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can't fill. Not because they haven't tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough. As a Talent Partner looking after our clients, you own those relationships. You take a role briefing properly, you push back when it doesn't add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they've even decided to hire. You will also own delivery: ensuring that our clients receive an amazing experience using Dex. You'll also be a power user of our product. We use Dex on our own hiring every day, and the feedback loop between you and the people building it should be strong. In this role you will: Own a portfolio of client relationships end to end; brief, delivery, feedback, and everything after Take role briefs / kick-offs that actually hold up. Scope the role, interrogate the requirements, and tell a client when the role is really two roles, or shouldn't be hired at all Run the process on the client side: keep feedback fast, keep interviews moving, keep momentum from breaking Analyse their Dex pipelines with conviction and manage expectations so offers land Negotiate offers with the client. Get people over the line without either side feeling managed Grow accounts. Turn a single search into a relationship; more roles, more trust, more of the hiring plan Be the client's most useful call of the week; delivering market insights, clear pipeline reporting, honest candidate reads, and effective advice About you You are highly organised, compelling, smart, and driven. You're commercially sharp and comfortable holding your ground with senior people. You'd rather have the awkward conversation early than the expensive one late. You tell great stories, and you know how to engage with a wide variety of different people - such as a first-time founder, a Head of Engineering, or a VP of Talent. You're credible with technical hiring managers and you understand how to be an effective partner to your stakeholders. You know enough about software engineering to be taken seriously, and you're honest about what you don't know. You have an excellent command of talent metrics. You know what good looks like at each stage of a funnel, and you use those numbers to diagnose and address a stalling process. You can walk a client through their own data, show them where they're losing people and why. We're open on backgrounds. Most people who do this well have 2+ years in recruitment (agency or internal) but if you've got the raw ingredients and the drive we want to talk to you. We want people who have excelled in their current and previous roles. We are looking for someone that is incredibly motivated to build an exceptional team, solving a problem that truly matters. Note: We know that talent can't be summed up in a few bullet points. Even if you don't match everything we've mentioned, we don't want that to be a barrier. If you're excited about what we're building, we want to hear from you. Why this is a great opportunity Dex represents an opportunity to join a well funded, cash generative business that works with some of the most interesting people and companies in the world. You'll be building relationships with some of the best AI startups and scaleups on the planet, and helping them hire the roles they care most about. We're growing fast and are set to more than double in headcount between the UK and US over the next 12 months. This is a team that deeply understands hiring, how difficult and how important it is; you'll have experienced talent leaders around you day to day, and a product team building tools for you specifically. What we offer Above market base salary plus uncapped commission; we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition Significant equity - we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take Full private healthcare & dental - because life happens and we want to support you Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support Gym membership & wellness benefits Claude tokens - lots and lots of Claude tokens Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip MacBook Pro + team kit "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support The process Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and respectful of your time. Here's what you can expect: Hiring Manager Interview: Richard, who heads up Talent Operations at Dex (30-45m) Short Take Home Exercise In person interview Task Review (60m) Culture Fit & Values (45m) Final Interview with Paddy, CEO and Founder at Dex (30m) Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Humboldt is a subteam of Flex Trading Enablement (Trading Optimisation). We sit at the intersection of commercial energy trading and the green transition, and we own Asset Backed Trading. Asset Backed Trading went live in March 2026. It already runs in two countries, with more markets and features on the way. There is a lot of room to shape how it is built. It models trading, ancillary service allocation, and dispatch for EU portfolios of batteries, solar and wind. We take market and position updates from Flex APIs, allocate energy and services that help stabilise the grid such as FCR and aFRR across the portfolio, and disaggregate those decisions to individual sites. We can both help traders make decisions about how to trade, and disaggregate said trades into per-asset dispatch decisions. This is production software with genuine commercial and operational impact. It not only support key traders' workflows, but also it drives physical asset dispatch and the delivery of grid services, so we care a lot about getting it right. You will work with data scientists and traders to turn prototypes into reliable, well tested services they can trust. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Humboldt and help shape Asset Backed Trading as it grows into new countries and capabilities. You will work in a Python monorepo of serverless services: event driven pipelines that ingest market and asset data, build optimisation problems, call solvers, and write dispatch and trading positions back out. You will also help evolve the interfaces with other Flex services and APIs that Asset Backed Trading depends on. Core skills Strong Python experience Experience building and operating backend services in production Comfort with cloud platforms, ideally AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3) API design and domain modelling for complex business workflows Writing robust, typed, well tested code (pytest, CI, 100% branch coverage, a real interest in catching bugs before production) Strong communication and collaboration with both engineers and non engineers Judgement in ambiguity: you can make trade offs explicit and keep delivery moving Nice to have / especially relevant Experience in problem solving, modelling, optimisation. Event driven or serverless architectures at meaningful scale Infrastructure as Code (CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform) Experience with Pydantic, strict typing, and mypy Observability in production (CloudWatch, Grafana) Exposure to energy, trading, optimisation, or other constraint heavy domains Working in a monorepo with shared libraries and multiple deployable services You do not need a background in energy or mathematical optimisation. Curiosity about the domain and a willingness to learn from traders and data scientists matters more than arriving with grid expertise. description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10, 000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role Self-serve today represents a meaningful part of Paddle's revenue. This role owns the commercial mandate to grow that significantly. Not just to run self-serve, but to build the strategy for where and how it scales, and execute against it. We're hiring a Director of Self-Serve to take full commercial ownership of Paddle's self-serve motion, running and scaling it as a business line. Self-serve is a material and fast-moving part of our revenue, and it needs an owner who thinks in unit economics, not just funnel metrics. You'll set the strategic direction, and work across Finance, Product, Engineering, Demand Generation, Partnerships, and RevOps to align everyone behind it. Getting this right is a genuinely cross-functional endeavour, and your ability to bring people with you will be just as important as your commercial acumen. You'll operate with a small, focused team including engineering capacity. This is a role for someone who wants to build and run the engine hands on, not manage through layers. What you'll do Own the line. Carry the commercial number for self-serve end to end, from acquisition through adoption, to revenue and net retention. Own the unit economics, and how they improve. Set the strategy. Form a clear commercial view of where self-serve creates value, ensure Finance and Product alignment, and translate it into a plan the business can execute against. Own activation and time-to-value. Evolve who and how we onboard through self-serve, how we nurture them through lifecycle stages, and the in-product experience that gets them to value fast. Increasing volume while decreasing time-to-value, not trading one for the other. You fundamentally approach the self-serve experience as a product, running structured discovery and experimentation, not defaulting to only marketing levers. Shape the demand. Define the customer profile that makes the economics work and work collaboratively with Demand Generation on the targeting you need, co-owning a single funnel against a shared ICP. Orchestrate cross-functionally. Codify the work into clear streams with clear owners, influence the Product, Engineering, and Risk roadmaps, and run a regular business cadence that keeps people aligned on priorities and impact. Deepen partner integrations. Work hand-in-glove with Partnerships to turn distribution relationships into deep well-integrated channels, owning the commercial outcome of partner-sourced volume. Build and run the engine. Design and run the experimentation, tooling, and tracking to improve funnel codification, time-to-value, activation, and conversion using AI where it raises velocity and quality, applied to the right customer. As the motion scales, you'll shape the team around it. Make the economics stack up. Working closely with finance you own self-serve pricing and packaging as a lever, to ensure profitable scale. How you operate Go get the answer yourself. When something doesn't add up, you pull the data, run the analysis, and don't wait to be handed a conclusion. Self-reliance is core to how you operate, not a fallback when support isn't available. You interrogate, not just observe. Live the ‘five whys’ principle, with the ability to take a plausible looking number, trend, signal and stress-test it until you've found the actual driver, not the first explanation that fits. You default to hypothesis and experiment before you default to opinion or output, treating the funnel as something to be iteratively shaped, not just optimised within. Given a mission, you don't let go of it. You have a real hunger to find and unlock value you believe is there, working through blockers, organisational, technical, or data. A sharp critical thinker who interrogates the brief rather than taking it at face value, challenges assumptions (including ours), and is as willing to conclude "this isn't where we should be investing" as to confirm the plan. A credible presence in front of senior stakeholders up to executive level; you communicate with clarity and authority and can take a room with competing priorities to a clear decision. Equally comfortable operating at altitude and dropping into the detail, and always coming back up with a point of view, not just findings. Able to use AI pragmatically; dynamic onboarding, predictive scoring, real-time segmentation, as a means to commercial outcomes, not an end in itself. raw.description:
About The Alliance

When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.


The Role

Our executive programmes only work if the right people are in the room. As Executive Audience Manager, you own the audience for our invitation-only events. You identify the senior leaders who belong at each table, you earn their attention, and you convert that attention into confirmed, qualified, high-value attendance. Our Content and Events teams build the experience. You build the room.

You'll work closely with Commercial, Partnerships and Marketing, and you'll own the executive relationship end to end: from first touch and qualification, through confirmation and show-up, to the follow-up that turns a one-time attendee into a long-term member of the community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the target audience: Work with Commercial and Marketing to translate each event's brief into a clear, named list of the executives who should be there, and the seniority and profile criteria that qualify them.

  • Build and run executive outreach. Own multi-channel campaigns across personalised email, LinkedIn, phone, referrals and warm introductions. Own the volume, own the follow-up, own the pipeline.

  • Qualify rigorously. Confirm seniority, decision-making authority, budget relevance and peer fit before an invitation is issued. Protect the quality of the room, including when that means saying no.

  • Convert and hold attendance. Manage invitations, confirmations, pre-event communications and reconfirmation with a white-glove touch. Minimise drop-out and keep every confirmed guest engaged right up to the day.

  • Hand over cleanly. Give the Events and Content teams a fully briefed, confirmed audience ahead of every event, with the profile detail they need to run the room well.

  • Retain and grow. Maintain relationships after the event, drive repeat attendance, and grow our executive communities through referrals and exclusive engagement opportunities.

  • Share what you learn. Capture commercial and market insight from your conversations, keep the CRM clean and current, and give internal teams warm, well-briefed handovers.

What Success Looks Like: You are measured on the quality and reliability of the audience you deliver.

Success means every event opens with a full room of genuinely senior, genuinely relevant executives who wanted to be there. It means low drop-out, high repeat attendance and a growing pool of executive relationships that belong to The Alliance rather than to any single campaign. It means Commercial and Event teams who trust that when you say the audience is secured, it is secured. And it means attendees who accept the next invitation because the last one was worth their evening.

What We're Looking For

  • Relevant experience could be in executive audience acquisition, B2B events, executive networking, partnerships, business development, or community building.

  • Comfortable approaching, engaging and holding the attention of C-suite and senior decision-makers, mostly by email, LinkedIn and phone.

  • A closer's instinct for follow-up. You are persistent without being a nuisance, and you don't lose people in the gap between interest and confirmation.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. Your outreach reads like a person, not a template

  • Highly organised with the attention to detail that white-glove executive handling demands.

  • Comfortable owning a target and working to a deadline that does not move, because the event date does not move.

  • Experience using CRM platforms, LinkedIn, and outreach tools is an advantage.

What This Role Is Not

To help you self-select: this is not an event production, logistics or on-site hosting role. You will not be sourcing venues, running the operational build or working the room on the night. Our Events team owns all of that. This is an acquisition and relationship role, and your week is spent in outreach and conversation with senior executives.

Benefits: We believe exceptional people deserve exceptional support.

Time Off:

  • 34 days' annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays.

  • Your birthday is off every year.

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Enhanced family policies.

  • Private Medical Insurance.

  • On-demand therapy, coaching, and mental fitness support through Oliva.

  • Heavily subsidised gym membership via Wellness Hub.

  • Flexible working hours, allowing you to work when you are most productive.

Equipment & Culture

  • New tech setup including laptop, screen, mouse, and keyboard.
