raw.title: Director, Partnerships
raw.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is building it's UK business from the ground up. We are looking for a Director of Partnerships to be the senior commercial owner of Ramp’s partner ecosystem in the UK: creating the relationships, market presence, and repeatable routes to revenue that help make Ramp a category-defining company in the region.

Reporting to the VP of Channel Sales, you will operate as a founder for Partnerships in London. You will build a focused partner strategy, develop executive-level relationships, and turn the right relationships into durable commercial outcomes. You will work closely with the UK go-to-market team and cross-functional leaders across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to make partnerships a meaningful driver of market entry and long-term growth.

This is not a role for someone looking to inherit a mature playbook. The right person is entrepreneurial, commercially sharp, and comfortable creating clarity where there is none. They can move from a first meeting with a senior executive to a clear point of view, an internal plan, and disciplined follow-through.

What You'll Do

  • Own and execute Ramp’s UK partnerships strategy, identifying the partner categories and individual relationships that can accelerate awareness, pipeline, customer value, and long-term market position

  • Build and maintain senior relationships across the UK ecosystem, including accounting, private equity and venture capital firms, professional-services and consulting firms, financial institutions, technology partners, and other high-leverage channels

  • Work alongside the UK Channel Partner Managers, aligning the broader ecosystem strategy with Ramp’s dedicated motions and creating leverage across shared relationships

  • Develop a focused partnership plan for priority relationships: articulate the joint value proposition, define the commercial path, and create mutual accountability for progress

  • Generate measurable commercial impact by sourcing and influencing pipeline, creating warm paths to target customers, and supporting strategic deals through partner relationships

  • Represent Ramp with credibility at executive meetings, industry events, and partner forums, building the company’s reputation as a serious, long-term UK partner

  • Serve as the internal voice of the UK partner market, translating relationship intelligence, customer needs, and market dynamics into actionable input for Sales, Product, Marketing, and leadership

  • Build the operating cadence for the function, including account plans, partnership scorecards, executive briefs, pipeline visibility, and clear follow-through across internal and external stakeholders

  • Help shape Ramp’s broader UK and European go-to-market strategy as the market, team, and partnership portfolio grow

What You Need

  • 10+ years of experience in sales, partnerships, business development, alliances, or go-to-market leadership, with a demonstrated record of building senior relationships and driving commercial outcomes

  • A proven track record of owning revenue, quota, influenced pipeline, or similarly concrete commercial goals in a complex B2B environment

  • Executive presence and sound judgment: you can earn credibility with senior partner leaders and represent Ramp confidently in consequential conversations

  • A builder mindset. You have launched a territory, vertical, business line, or partner motion, and know how to create a plan and operating rhythm from a blank page

  • The ability to turn broad relationships into specific opportunities, navigate multiple stakeholders, and maintain momentum through long sales and partnership cycles

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to decide where Ramp should invest and make a clear, data-informed case to senior leadership

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build a compelling partnership narrative and align cross-functional teams around it

  • AI fluency as a daily habit. Ramp is a builder culture: if you do not instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment

  • Ability to work five days per week from Ramp’s London office, with willingness to travel across the UK and continental Europe as needed

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling or partnering into private equity, financial services, consulting, enterprise technology, or high-growth software companies

  • Experience in fintech, financial software, payments, spend management, or the office of the CFO technology ecosystem

  • An established UK network of senior commercial, investment, operating, or technology leaders

  • Experience building a new market or international go-to-market motion

  • Fluency in an additional European language

Why Ramp

  • Own one of Ramp’s most important external-facing growth mandates as we build the UK business

  • Work directly with senior leaders across Channel, Sales, Product, and Marketing, with the autonomy to shape the market strategy and the accountability to deliver commercial outcomes

  • Build at the intersection of fintech, AI, and enterprise software at a company redefining how businesses manage spend

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Pet insurance

raw.description:
Product Design Engineer – Sustaining & Improvement

Location:
Concept House, Brackenbeck Road, Bradford, BD7 2LW

Reports To:
Technical Manager

Salary
Salary is negotiable and will reflect the successful candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications.

Job Purpose

Debar designs and manufactures bifold door hardware and complete bifold door systems for customers in the UK and international markets. As we invest in future growth, new product development and the continued improvement of our existing product portfolio, we are creating a new Product Design Engineer position within our Technical Engineering team.

The primary focus of the role will be the ongoing engineering integrity, design improvement and evolution of Debar's released products. The successful candidate will investigate product issues, develop engineering solutions and lead the technical content of product changes.

While the principal focus will be existing products, the role will also contribute to larger product improvements and new development projects according to business priorities and team capacity.

Our products integrate precision mechanical hardware with aluminium profiles, requiring strong mechanical design judgement and an understanding of how changes can affect the performance of the wider bifold door system.

Key Responsibilities

Product Sustaining, Improvement & Engineering Change

  • Take technical design ownership of engineering issues and improvements relating to Debar's existing bifold hardware, systems and wider released product portfolio.
  • Investigate product failures, recurring issues, customer complaints and warranty matters, developing robust engineering solutions and corrective product improvements where required.
  • Redesign components and assemblies where required to improve performance, reliability, durability or cost.
  • Assess the wider impact of proposed changes on mating components, aluminium profiles and overall system performance.
  • Carry out tolerance analysis and tolerance stack-ups where required to resolve fit, function or performance issues.
  • Lead the engineering content of product change requests, ensuring changes are properly assessed, documented and progressed through Debar's engineering change process.
  • Create and update 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, specifications and Bills of Materials associated with product changes.
  • Own and maintain the technical content of documentation for released products, including end-user, fabrication and installation manuals, technical bulletins and supporting product information.
  • Maintain accurate technical product data and configurations within relevant industry software, including Logikal, ensuring that approved profiles, hardware, rules and product changes are correctly reflected.
  • Support product changes arising from supplier changes, material changes, component availability, obsolescence or alternative manufacturing requirements.
  • Identify and progress opportunities for proactive product improvement and value engineering.

Testing, Technical Issues & Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Debar's Compliance & Testing function to support testing or validation required as a result of product changes.
  • Support prototype components, trials and validation activity where required.
  • Liaise with customers, system partners and internal commercial teams on technical issues relating to existing products, investigating concerns and developing appropriate engineering solutions.
  • Work with suppliers on technical issues, alternative components, tooling changes and manufacturing feasibility.
  • Communicate the technical implications of product changes clearly to relevant internal and external stakeholders.

Product Development Support

  • Contribute to larger improvements and enhancements to Debar's existing bifold hardware and systems.
  • Support new product and system development projects according to business priorities and Technical Engineering resource requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with Product Development engineers on projects requiring shared expertise or additional capacity.

Person Specification

Essential Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • Degree, HND or equivalent recognised higher-level qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering or a closely related discipline. A relevant formal qualification is mandatory.
  • Relevant professional experience in mechanical design, product design or product development engineering.
  • Strong capability in parametric 3D CAD and manufacturing-ready engineering drawings.
  • Experience designing and modifying physical products or components for manufacture.
  • Strong understanding of Design for Manufacture, dimensional tolerances, engineering fits and tolerance stack-up analysis.
  • Practical understanding of mechanical engineering, materials and relevant manufacturing processes.
  • Strong mechanical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to progress engineering work independently while collaborating effectively across different functions.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Fenestration, windows, doors, aluminium architectural systems or other moving door systems.
  • Mechanical or architectural hardware such as hinges, rollers, guides, handles or locks.
  • Small precision components involving aluminium extrusions, zinc or aluminium castings, mouldings or CNC-machined parts.
  • Product sustaining engineering, continuous product improvement or engineering change.
  • Failure investigation, corrective product redesign, value engineering or component substitution.
  • Product testing, validation, tooling or supplier development.
  • Autodesk Inventor is strongly preferred; experienced SolidWorks, Creo or comparable CAD users will also be considered. AutoCAD and ERP experience would be beneficial.
  • Producing controlled technical product documentation or maintaining product and configuration data within Logikal or comparable industry software.

Direct experience designing or improving bifold door hardware or systems would be particularly valuable but is not an essential requirement.

Attributes

  • Practical, curious and interested in understanding how mechanical products perform and can be improved.
  • Methodical and detail-conscious when managing engineering changes.
  • Able to balance product performance, quality, manufacturability and cost.
  • Collaborative, self-motivated and comfortable taking technical ownership of defined issues and projects.

Working Conditions

  • Full-time, permanent role based primarily at Debar’s Bradford facility, with one day per week homeworking currently available.
  • Occasional travel may be required for supplier visits, product trials, customer projects or testing.

description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out. You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend. You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops. You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week. What you’ll work on Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further. Now Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business. Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure. Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel. Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics. Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team. Next Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating. Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly. Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users. Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area. Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it. Later Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting. Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work. Support company secretarial administration. About you We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most. Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability. Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go. Ironclad or equivalent CLM: Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a directly comparable enterprise CLM (for example Juro, LinkSquares, Icertis, Agiloft, Leah). We are deeply embedded in Ironclad and you will own it. Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership. End-to-end project delivery: You have owned legal or cross-functional projects on your own steam, including timelines, risks, stakeholders and outcomes. Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on. Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch. Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage. Benefits We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel. Financial & Insurance Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market) Equity Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%) Private Medical Insurance Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness Group Life Assurance Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes Time off 25 holiday days per year Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days) Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work Work abroad for up to 3 months a year 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available Training & Culture Professional learning and development budget AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools Quarterly team socials Summer and Winter company social events 9fin is an equal opportunities employer At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. title: CENTRALE LYON - Ingénieur informatique / EDA – Qualification d’outils, modèles et IP
description: Présentation département L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon. Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement. Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement. Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs. Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR Présentation de la ou les thématiques : Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. Il implique plusieurs laboratoires du CNRS (INL, TIMA, IRISA, IETR, LIP6, LIRMM, LAMIH, IMS, Lab Hubert Curien, Lab-STICC…), le CEA-LIST, ainsi que de nombreux partenaires académiques et industriels. Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) ingénieur(e) informatique / EDA chargé(e) de la qualification des outils, modèles et blocs IP utilisés et développés au sein de PHOENIX, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche, les doctorants et les partenaires industriels. Description de la ou les missions / les activités - Mettre en place, maintenir et faire évoluer l’environnement logiciel de conception (flow EDA) pour les partenaires du consortium PHOENIX (CAO, simulation, caractérisation, PDK, IP). - Qualifier les outils EDA (commercials et open source), modèles de dispositifs et blocs IP : définition de bancs de tests, métriques de performance, protocoles d’évaluation et rapports de validation. - Participer à l’intégration et à l’évaluation de méthodes d’EDA augmentées par l’IA (optimisation de flows, génération de modèles, analyse automatique de résultats, etc.). - Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, interface avec les fournisseurs d’outils et les équipes IT locales). - Contribuer à la rédaction de livrables techniques du projet : documents de spécification, rapports de qualification, guides d’utilisation des outils et IP. - Mettre en place de bonnes pratiques pour la gestion de versions, la traçabilité des résultats, l’automatisation des flows (scripts, CI/CD, conteneurisation). - Participer à la veille technologique sur les outils EDA, les librairies IP, les technologies de calcul avancées et proposer des évolutions du parc logiciel. Profil recherché / Compétences attendues________________________________ Diplômes : Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master 2 ou doctorat en informatique, microélectronique ou domaine proche. Expérience : Débutant accepté Compétences opérationnelles : - Solides compétences en EDA (front-end et/ou back-end) : RTL, synthèse, P&R, extraction, simulation (SPICE, mixed-signal, etc.), PDK, caractérisation. - Maîtrise de scripts et automatisation (Python, Shell, Make, ou équivalent) et aisance avec les environnements Linux. - Connaissance souhaitée des architectures matérielles pour l’IA, des technologies émergentes ou de la conception de chiplets. - Intérêt marqué pour la qualité logicielle et la validation : tests, métriques, reproductibilité, documentation. - Excellent sens de la communication et du travail en équipe dans un environnement multi-sites et pluridisciplinaire. - Maîtrise du français et bonne pratique de l’anglais technique (échanges avec partenaires et fournisseurs, rédaction de rapports).   Contexte de travail / Environnement de travail_______________________________ - Localisation principale : Ecole Centrale de Lyon (Ecully, Lyon), avec déplacements ponctuels sur les sites partenaires. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description: Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines. In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device. The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks: Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow. Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints. Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system. Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency. Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads. Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption. Required Candidate Profile The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field , and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills: Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus. Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset. System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus. Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing. Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation. Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English. Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Rejoins Fastned pour accélérer la transition énergétique ! Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide. Nos avantages Chez Fastned, on travaille avec ambition pour avoir un impact réel, et on prend le temps de reconnaître et célébrer nos réussites, qu’elles soient grandes ou petites. On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly. Nos avantages : Un budget formation et développement de 3 000€ brut par an par collaborateur, car le développement et la formation sont importants pour nous et notre secteur offre des opportunités infinies. Voiture de fonction électrique avec frais de recharge couverts. Carte Ticket Restaurant, 12,20€ par jour.  25 jours de congés + RTT + 2 jours de Mission Days que tu peux utiliser pour contribuer aux missions de Fastned et soutenir une cause associative qui te tient à cœur. Fastned prend en charge 60 % de ta mutuelle Alan et 100 % de ton salaire pendant les 30 premiers jours d’absence pour maladie/incapacité de travail. Un abonnement Gymlib avec accès à un large réseau de salles de sport et studios. Plan de stock options -> nous croyons à la création de valeur partagée. Bien-être mental avec nilo health : accès à une plateforme de santé mentale confidentielle offrant des séances de coaching individuel avec des psychologues, des sessions de groupe et une variété d’outils. Des événements festifs: Ski trip, Fastned Days, team buildings - des temps forts pour se retrouver, échanger et célébrer nos réussites. Envie d'en savoir plus ? On serait ravis d'avoir une conversation avec toi ! Envoie-nous ton CV et dis-nous en plus, pourquoi Fastned, et pourquoi toi. Le processus de recrutement se déroule en 4 étapes : Entretien vidéo avec notre recruteuse ; Entretien vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France ; Case study vidéo avec la Lead Expansion France, et deux membres de l’équipe ; Team coffee chats dans nos locaux parisiens pour rencontrer les collègues de l’équipe France. The key goal is to grow the share of high quality stays by optimising supply at scale leveraging strategic account management, programs, incentives,&nbsp; and product solutions.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Key Accounts Manager, you will be managing partner relationships with strategic Enterprises &amp; API Connectivity partners. title: Principal Application Engineer
description: <p>Application Modernization Platform (“AMP”) is a MongoDB offering that modernises our customer’s legacy relational applications to a modern architecture underpinned by MongoDB using a combination of software, processes, and engineers. In this offering, the people and software are inextricably linked and cannot be separated. The delivery happens in an accelerated timeframe wherein the team takes advantage of GenAI and algorithmic tooling to expedite the turnaround time for application delivery.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>AMP team generally works with enterprise-grade customers, in all verticals on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, addresses multiple customer-facing opportunities. The role also becomes the forefront of groundbreaking R&amp;D that enables further acceleration for enterprises working across a variety of technologies.</p> <p>AMP exists to expedite time to value for customers who are looking forward to changing, modernising and updating their tech stack while keeping MongoDB the cornerstone of their system architecture.</p> <p>Work as a software developer in an Agile environment delivering solutions for customers focused on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. During each project, successful candidates will be required to innovate on potential new GenAI-based solutions for specific challenges in addition to applying existing playbooks and tooling for migration.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in France.</p> <h3><strong>Position Expectations</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Shape architecture and technology strategy across AMP modernization projects and workstreams, making complex technical decisions with limited supervision and connecting engineering choices to customer and business outcomes</li> <li>Lead the assessment and modernization of legacy Java applications by uncovering dependencies, embedded business logic, integration points, and operational constraints; recommend fit-for-purpose modernization paths rather than defaulting to lift-and-shift</li> <li>Design, implement, and review production-quality solutions using Java and Spring Boot, including APIs, integrations, monolith decomposition, relational-to-document data modeling, stored-procedure transformation, schema evolution, and MongoDB operational practices</li> <li>Establish safe, incremental delivery practices through explicit acceptance criteria, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and rollback, dual-run, or other risk-control strategies; identify quality, security, performance, and reliability risks and guide teams to resolve them</li> <li>Serve as a senior technical partner to customers, application owners, and account and project stakeholders by explaining complex topics clearly, aligning priorities, navigating disagreement, communicating trade-offs, and maintaining trust through high-risk change</li> <li>Multiply the effectiveness of engineers by mentoring, raising engineering standards, creating reusable migration playbooks and documentation, applying GenAI advancements responsibly where valuable, and influencing project direction without relying on formal authority</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience</li> <li>Typically 8+ years of progressive experience designing, building, and delivering Java applications, including significant experience leading complex application modernization initiatives</li> <li>Expert understanding of Java fundamentals, object-oriented design, concurrency, error handling, performance considerations, and maintainable software architecture; able to review code and guide design decisions across teams</li> <li>Deep production experience with Spring Boot and related patterns for building resilient services, APIs, integrations, and testable distributed applications</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to assess legacy estates, decompose monoliths, uncover dependencies and embedded business logic, and define practical modernization strategies with clear trade-offs</li> <li>Strong experience with relational databases and SQL, including stored procedures, data dependencies, data migration, schema evolution, and relational-to-document modeling for MongoDB or comparable document databases</li> <li>Proven history of delivering high-cadence modern applications using Agile methodologies, test-first development, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, observability, and reliability practices; demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical outcomes across teams</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in building REST APIs with Spring Boot</li> <li>Experience in performance and memory optimization of JAVA applications</li> <li>Familiarity with tools like Postman, IntelliJ IDEA, and Maven/Gradle</li> <li>Exposure to other languages or technologies like JavaScript, .Net</li> <li>Understanding of ORM tools like Hibernate, Spring Data&nbsp; or JPA (even through coursework or self-study)</li> <li>Experience in nascent GenAI technologies and approaches, such as using OpenAI/Anthropic API not purely through chat interfaces</li> <li>Experience with AI-powered development tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar code assistants</li> <li>Good experience of using MongoDB</li> </ul> <p>Successful candidates will engage with customer systems and may be exposed to highly confidential customer data, including but not limited to non-public information. For this reason, and due to the nature of the highly regulated industry in which our customers operate, successful candidates may be subject to enhanced background checks, security screenings, and possible constraints around the trading of securities. Successful candidates will understand these requirements and be willing to participate in enhanced screenings and constraints as required by MongoDB and its customers in connection with this role.&nbsp;</p> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID: 3273528270</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media&nbsp;:</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.&nbsp;</em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.&nbsp;<br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&nbsp;<br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients.&nbsp;Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Pour notre client Richemont, 3ème groupe mondial du Luxe, propriétaire des Maisons emblématiques Cartier, Van Cleef &amp; Arpels, Piaget, Vacheron Constantin, Jaeger-LeCoultre, IWC Schaffhausen, Panerai, Dunhill and Montblanc… nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire pour venir renforcer notre équipe Data &amp; Tech.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Participer au processus d’audit et d’amélioration de la qualité de données des campagnes publicitaires pour le client.</li> <li>Contribuer à l’élaboration et au déploiement d’outils et des techniques d'IA.</li> <li>Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques en matière de qualité des données auprès des différentes équipes.</li> <li>Accompagner les membres de l’agence dans l’adoption et l’utilisation des outils Data &amp; Tech.</li> <li>Assurer le respect des directives digitales globales de Richemont.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <ul> <li>En bac +4/+5 en école d’ingénieur ou de commerce spécialisation digitale, data, tech, à la recherche d'un stage de 5 mois minimum</li> <li>Une passion pour les médias, la publicité et les nouvelles technologies.</li> <li>Une bonne capacité d’analyse et d’interprétation des données et des chiffres</li> <li>Des qualités de chef de projet&nbsp;: coordination, agilité et priorisation des sujets</li> <li>Anglais&nbsp;: C1/C2 à l’oral et à l’écrit impératif <em>(une deuxième langue serait un atout)</em></li> <li>Outils&nbsp;: Excel (maîtrise des TCD et de RechercheX, Somme.si)</li> <li>Connaissance de Google Analytics ou autre outil d’attribution</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons&nbsp;:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas&nbsp;!</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3&nbsp;!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Business Director - F/H - CDI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media :</strong></p> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. Nous utilisons le pouvoir de la créativité pour construire un avenir meilleur pour nos collaborateurs, notre planète, nos clients et nos communautés. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wpp.com.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Être Extraordinaire</strong>&nbsp;en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li><strong>Créer un environnement Ouvert</strong>&nbsp;en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li><strong>Diriger avec Optimisme</strong>&nbsp;en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Le rôle</strong></h3> <p>Dans le cadre de l'accompagnement stratégique de notre client Subway, nous recherchons un&nbsp;<strong>Business Director (F/H)</strong>&nbsp;pour un poste clé et "intégré". La particularité de ce compte réside dans notre double gestion du&nbsp;<strong>Média</strong>&nbsp;et de la&nbsp;<strong>Création</strong>. Nous cherchons donc un profil capable d'incarner cette double expertise et d'orchestrer avec fluidité la collaboration entre les différentes entités du groupe (Studio M, VML, Data &amp; Tech, etc.).</p> <p>Rattaché à la Direction de l'agence, vous managerez directement une équipe de deux personnes et piloterez de manière transverse les équipes Stratégie, Data, Création et Influence pour garantir le succès des campagnes.</p> <p><strong>Responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Pilotage de la relation client :</strong>&nbsp;Devenir le point de contact unique et stratégique de la Directrice Marketing de Subway France, en portant des réflexions globales de marketing et communication pour piloter une relation client exigeante avec légitimité.</li> <li><strong>Intégration et Coordination Inter-Agences :</strong>&nbsp;Agir en tant que pivot pour fédérer et faire collaborer des équipes transverses (Média, Créa, Influence, Tech). Manager les synergies avec les différentes expertises internes, résoudre les frictions et clarifier les rôles pour assurer un collectif harmonieux et efficace.</li> <li><strong>Orientation Business, Data &amp; Stratégie :</strong>&nbsp;Suivre de très près la performance business du client (secteur Retail) via des outils de mesure et des modèles d'attribution (MMM). Allier l'évaluation de la performance chiffrée à une forte sensibilité créative pour maximiser l'impact des actions.</li> <li><strong>Leadership Stratégique :</strong>&nbsp;Être force de proposition et autonome dans la rédaction des recommandations stratégiques, en dépassant les sujets opérationnels pour inspirer le client et les équipes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences requises</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous représentez un équilibre rare entre une&nbsp;<strong>culture média</strong>&nbsp;et une&nbsp;<strong>culture créative</strong>. Idéalement, vous êtes issu d'une agence média avec une forte sensibilité créative et social media, ou d'une agence de création/planning stratégique avec une forte appétence pour la data et le business.</li> <li>Une connaissance approfondie de la&nbsp;<strong>"Street Culture" &amp; Gen Z</strong>&nbsp;est indispensable pour comprendre et activer les codes de la marque.</li> <li>Une expérience ou une forte sensibilité au secteur du&nbsp;<strong>Retail</strong>&nbsp;et aux logiques de trafic en magasin est un plus indéniable.</li> <li>Vous êtes un profil solide, expérimenté et autonome, capable d'écrire et de porter des recommandations stratégiques de haut niveau.</li> <li>Vous faites preuve de <strong>fermeté </strong>et de&nbsp;<strong>leadership</strong>&nbsp;pour vous imposer avec assurance auprès des équipes internes et du client.</li> <li>Votre forte capacité d'<strong>incarnation</strong>&nbsp;vous permet de porter le projet d'intégration média-création auprès de toutes les parties prenantes.</li> <li>Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est recommandé</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p>Nos avantages comprennent :</p> <ul> <li>Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année</li> <li>Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte</li> <li>Jours de congé additionnels par pallier de 5 ans d’ancienneté</li> <li>5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose</li> <li>Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH</li> <li>Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act</li> <li>Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes (y compris des outils internes de reporting).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong>&nbsp;Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement :</strong>&nbsp;Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec l’équipe Talent. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li><strong>Entretiens opérationnels :</strong>&nbsp;Une rencontre avec vos futurs managers. Au moins un entretien physique est obligatoire.</li> <li><strong>Étude de cas :</strong>&nbsp;Réalisation d'un Business Case pour évaluer votre capacité d'analyse, votre rigueur, votre résolution de problèmes et votre maîtrise des outils.</li> </ul> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données politique de confidentialité.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:


🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

raw.title: (Senior) Social Brand Manager (all genders)
raw.description:
They do 08/15. We create 9:16

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als (Senior) Social Brand Manager (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Beratung mit sicherem Account Management und konsequenter operativer Steuerung. Als verlängerter Arm unserer Kund:innen und strategische Stimme von WeCreate sorgst du dafür, dass aus Plattform- und Community-Signalen klare Entscheidungen, relevante Aktivierungen und messbare Markenwirkung werden.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest eigenständig Kund:innen Etats im Daily Business und führst sie sicher durch ihr Full-Social-System. Dabei steuerst du sowohl strategisch als auch operativ: von der Plattformstrategie und Aktivierungsplanung über Content, Community und Creator bis hin zu Performance, Budget und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

Du denkst Social nicht in einzelnen Gewerken, sondern als integriertes System. Du hältst Markenführung, kreative Qualität, operative Umsetzung, Paid Media und Business-Ziele zusammen mit klarer Haltung, strukturiertem Account Management und einem sicheren Gespür dafür, was auf Plattformen und in Communities funktioniert.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du agierst als verlängerter Arm deiner Kund:innen und zugleich als strategische Stimme von WeCreate. Du schaffst Orientierung, wenn Plattformen, Trends und Anforderungen in Bewegung sind, und hältst Markenambition, kreative Exzellenz, operative Umsetzung und wirtschaftliche Ziele zusammen.

Du bist mehr als Schnittstelle: Du erkennst, was eine Marke jetzt braucht, übersetzt es in klare Social-Maßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Systeme, die langfristig Relevanz aufbauen und Wachstum ermöglichen.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategisches Account Management: Du führst Kund:innen eigenständig auf Senior-Level, berätst sie zur ganzheitlichen Full-Social-Präsenz und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
  • Strategische und operative Steuerung: Du übersetzt Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Aktivierungspläne und priorisierte To-dos – auch über mehrere Projekte hinweg.
  • Channel Ownership: Du entwickelst plattformgerechte Strategien und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte zu Marke, Zielgruppe, Community und Plattformlogik passen.
  • Projekt-, Produktions- und Content-Steuerung: Du verantwortest Social-Aktivierungen, Redaktionsplanung und Produktionen von der Konzeption bis zur Freigabe. Dabei sicherst du markenkonsistenten, plattformnativen Content mit klarer Wirkungserwartung.
  • Creator- und Community-Management: Du steuerst Creator-Kooperationen ganzheitlich – von Auswahl und Verhandlung bis zu Briefing und Auswertung. Community-Learnings und kulturelle Signale übersetzt du in relevante Empfehlungen.
  • Performance-, Budget- und Paid-Media-Kompetenz: Du interpretierst Daten, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, steuerst Budgets und Wirtschaftlichkeit und integrierst Paid Media in deine Full-Funnel-Beratung.
  • Fachliches Sparring und Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst Standards für Creator Management, Measurement und AI-gestützte Prozesse weiter, bringst dein Wissen ins Team ein und stärkst Strategie- und Creative-Kompetenz.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Prioritäten und umsetzbare Pläne übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung anspruchsvoller Kund:innenetats oder Retainer – von Beratung und Planung bis Umsetzung, Performance-Review und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du beherrschst Full Social: Plattformstrategie, Content-Systeme, Community, Creator und Paid Media gehören für dich zu einer wirksamen Markenführung zusammen.

  • Du steuerst Projekte, Budgets, Aufwände und Stakeholder vorausschauend und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Creator Management mit – inklusive Auswahl, Verhandlung, Briefing, Steuerung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auswertung.

  • Du kannst Daten und Reportings analytisch einordnen, strategische Implikationen ableiten und Handlungsempfehlungen klar vermitteln.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content und Plattformkultur und kannst kreative Qualität konstruktiv, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe führen.


So arbeitest du

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und proaktiv – auch wenn sich Prioritäten, Plattformen oder Anforderungen verändern.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Abstimmung oder Steuerung nötig ist, und handelst entsprechend – mit Kund:innen, Creator:innen und im Team.

  • Du hältst strategische Prioritäten auch bei hohem Tempo im Blick und schaffst Orientierung, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu sparren und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

description: <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join the Clinical team in the AI and Machine Learning Department. You'll lead the technical direction of AI systems that enhance clinical decision-making and patient care. You'll tackle the hardest problems in healthcare AI, from building voice-powered consultation assistants to establishing LLM evaluation frameworks that ensure clinical safety and efficacy. This role&nbsp;<strong>combines deep R&amp;D with strategic technical leadership</strong>, shaping how Doctolib deploys AI in regulated healthcare environments.</p> <p>Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:</p> <p><strong>Technical Strategy &amp; Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the long-term technical roadmap for clinical ML systems, from model architecture selection to production deployment patterns</li> <li>Drive strategic build vs. buy decisions, balancing custom development with foundation model APIs</li> <li>Define standards for safe rollout in healthcare contexts: shadow testing, staged deployment, and human-in-the-loop workflows</li> </ul> <p><strong>End-to-End ML Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead design and implementation of LLM-powered clinical agents (consultation summarization, clinical coding, evidence-grounded recommendations)</li> <li>Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks using real-world clinical datasets, ensuring outputs meet clinical accuracy and safety standards</li> <li>Build production infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimization, and observability</li> <li>Define a bold strategy for online and offline performance objectives to reach new levels of healthcare professionals satisfaction</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mentor Staff or Senior ML Engineers and Applied Scientists, elevating technical standards across the organization</li> <li>Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Medical Affairs, Legal, and Compliance teams</li> <li>Translate clinical needs into research questions and production systems that measurably improve patient outcomes</li> <li>Partner with our medical, legal, and compliance teams to meet EU regulatory expectations (e.g., GDPR, MDR, upcoming EU AI Act) and market standards.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>Before you read on,&nbsp; if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.</p> <ul> <li>You have 10+ years in ML/AI with 3+ years at Staff+ or Principal level leading complex, multi-team technical initiatives</li> <li>You have a PhD in Computer Science, AI, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent research
